scheme_name: Ex-gratia for Permanent Disability/ Chronic Diseases/ Surgery/ Operation for the Construction Workers
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
other_conditions: The applicant must have engaged in building or other construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
The applicant must be a registered member under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of the UT
The applicant must have permanent disability, or chronic disease (of the applicant or their dependents), or require surgery/operation
Surgery/operation benefit excludes operations related to maternity
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹1,00,000 for permanent disability, up to ₹1,00,000 per year for chronic disease treatment, and ₹40,000 for surgery/operation (excluding maternity).
